title: Talks One Person Can Attend
statement:
A conference has `n` talks. Talk `i` runs from time `s_i` up to, but not including, time `e_i`. You can attend a talk only from its start to its end, and you cannot be in two talks at once. You can leave one talk and enter another at the same moment. Find the largest number of talks you can attend.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. Each of the next `n` lines contains `s_i` and `e_i`.

## Output
Print the largest number of talks you can attend.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 8000`
- `0 <= s_i < e_i <= 10^9`
